# color-management-decision

Purpose: Pin Display Device, View Transform, Look, and Sequencer per consumer pipeline (web sRGB, VFX ACES linear, game engine, print, GLB-Three.js) before render.

Avoid the most common Blender color mistake: rendering with the wrong color space and then "fixing" it in post. Pick the color management strategy upfront based on the consumer's color pipeline.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `render-and-output-decisions` | Role `view-transform-and-colorspace-selector` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- before render / lookdev pass
- when consumer color pipeline is known
- when a previous render had unexpected color shifts
- Trigger phrases: "what color space", "Filmic vs Standard", "ACEScg for our pipeline", "colors look weird"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- Post-render color grading or soft-proofing (handled by compositor / DCC after render). → use `output-format-decision` (`references/skill-output-format-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to output-format-decision)
- Validating per-material texture color spaces such as sRGB vs Non-Color/Linear (material-quality-checker). → use `material-quality-checker` (`references/skill-material-quality-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to material-quality-checker)
- Selecting file formats or bit depths (output-format-decision). → use `output-format-decision` (`references/skill-output-format-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to output-format-decision)
- Choosing the render engine (cycles-vs-eevee-decision). → use `cycles-vs-eevee-decision` (`references/skill-cycles-vs-eevee-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to cycles-vs-eevee-decision)
- Monitor hardware calibration (out of scope). → use `material-quality-checker` (`references/skill-material-quality-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to material-quality-checker)
- Raw modeling without lookdev (color management does not affect geometry accuracy). → use `cycles-vs-eevee-decision` (`references/skill-cycles-vs-eevee-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to cycles-vs-eevee-decision)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `target_delivery_pipeline` (`string`): Target display or compositing pipeline (web sRGB, product brand match, ACEScg VFX, HDR)
- Required input `blender_version_posture` (`string`): Target Blender version family (3.6 LTS Filmic, 4.0+ AgX, 5.1+ AgX/ACES)
- Optional input `brand_hex_swatch_constraints` (`array`): Optional strict brand hex colors requiring Standard vs tone-mapped tradeoffs
- Output contract: `pinned_view_transform_and_look`, `display_and_working_colorspace_spec`, `cross_engine_and_web_color_caveats` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. Identify the consumer pipeline (`web sRGB` / `film/VFX ACES linear` / `game engine` / `print` / `GLB-Three.js`).
2. Pin the 4-line render color config: `Display Device`, `View Transform`, `Look`, and `Sequencer`.
3. Define per-output color transforms if multiple outputs exist.
4. Emit the 4-line config record, caveats, truth states (`Not Run` / `Not Produced`), and handoff.

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Decision skill — does not run Blender. Pins config; operator applies in scene render properties.
- Validate per-material texture color spaces (`material-quality-checker`).
- Choose output file formats or bit depths (`output-format-decision`).
- Choose the render engine (`cycles-vs-eevee-decision`).
- Perform post-render color grading (belongs to compositor / DCC).
- Calibrate a physical monitor (out of scope).
- Run Blender or execute renders.
